excludedEntities.reason: The API/domain contracts describe appeal submission, but docs/63 marks implementation pending and the admitted W06 D1 migrations contain no Appeal persistence table or idempotency source. Do not invent physical schema until a dedicated Appeal persistence contract and source migration are admitted.
AuditEvent is W09-owned in D1-03. W06 continues its existing Cloudflare D1 compatibility path until a separate runtime-adapter slice; this schema does not create a second audit table.

constraints: case_id is the primary key and is never reused.

(case_id, case_version) is unique.
outcome values are APPROVED or REJECTED at the admitted contract/runtime boundary.

id must equal 1.
successful must equal 1.

decision_id is unique.
target_type is content.

(actor_user_id, target_type, target_id, reason_code, dedup_bucket) is unique.

postgresTypeMappings.other_text_columns: TEXT; opaque identifiers are not foreign keys.
